faqs.question: What Industries Does Tech Avenue Serve?
faqs.answer: Tech Avenue delivers integrated technology solutions across government, telecommunications, construction, education, agriculture, energy, cybersecurity, and enterprise sectors, helping organizations accelerate secure digital transformation.

faqs.question: What Services Does Tech Avenue Provide?
faqs.answer: We provide enterprise IT consulting, smart infrastructure, cloud and data solutions, cybersecurity services, and end-to-end system integration tailored to each organization's operating environment.

faqs.question: Does Tech Avenue Develop AI Solutions?

faqs.question: Can Tech Avenue Deliver End-To-End Digital Transformation Projects?

LegacySolutions.title: Network Security
LegacySolutions.description: Comprehensive protection for perimeter, endpoint, and cloud.
LegacySolutions.headerDescription: Defending distributed enterprise networks through layered detection, zero-trust access, and continuous monitoring built for organizations that cannot afford an open door.
LegacySolutions.overviewDescription:
Our client, a multinational financial group, operated a perimeter security model that no longer matched how their people actually worked. Remote staff, third-party contractors, and cloud workloads had all grown well beyond the boundary the original architecture was designed to defend.

We replaced that boundary with a zero-trust architecture in which every request is authenticated and authorized on its own merits. Detection, response, and access control now run from a single console, and the security team sees the whole estate rather than one segment of it.

NewsItems.title: Tech Avenue Announces Strategic AI Partnership with Global Infrastructure Leaders
NewsItems.description: A transformative alliance aimed at revolutionizing urban connectivity and digital resilience across continents through advanced neural networks.
NewsItems.html:
Tech Avenue has entered a multi-year alliance with a consortium of global infrastructure operators to bring adaptive AI models into the systems that move people, power, and data every day.

What the partnership covers

The agreement pairs our neural forecasting stack with operational telemetry from transit networks, energy grids, and metropolitan fibre estates across three continents. Joint teams will run shared pilots before any capability reaches general release.

  • Shared model development for demand and load forecasting
  • Co-funded resilience research on critical distribution assets
  • A common integration layer for partner operations centres

Why it matters

Operators have no shortage of sensor data — what they lack is a way to turn it into decisions fast enough to matter. This partnership puts the modelling work next to the people who run the assets, rather than several handoffs away.

We are not selling a dashboard. We are shortening the distance between a signal and a repair crew.

First joint deployments begin next quarter, with findings published as the pilots close.

NewsItems.title: New Cybersecurity Framework for Global Banking Launched
NewsItems.description: A unified controls baseline built with regional regulators to help banks detect and contain threats faster.
NewsItems.html:
Working alongside regional regulators, Tech Avenue has published a unified controls baseline that gives banks a single reference for detection, containment, and disclosure.

Inside the framework

The baseline maps existing supervisory expectations onto a common set of technical controls, so an institution operating in several jurisdictions can prove compliance once instead of five times.

  • Tiered detection requirements scaled to institution size
  • Containment playbooks for account takeover and lateral movement
  • A shared disclosure timeline agreed with participating regulators

Adoption

Eleven institutions took part in the drafting group, and early adopters report meaningfully shorter triage cycles during simulated incidents.

Events.html:
